classifications.authority_or_basis: Stripe identifies DLUSD as a custom stablecoin issued through Bridge Open Issuance; reviewed primary sources do not establish a narrower statutory token classification for SOG to assert.

notes: Existing canonical Bridge organization is reused. Exact issuing affiliate, holder legal claim, asset-specific reserve ownership, segregation and insolvency treatment remain unresolved; Deel-platform conversion back to USD value is recorded separately from direct issuer redemption.
